## Description

What the pull request changes, and why. If it fixes an issue, write "Fixes #" and its number.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request is against `develop`, not against `main`.
- [ ] The branch is about one topic only.
- [ ] The documentation is updated in the same branch: the README of the control in `Docs`, the XML documentation of the sources, the demos where they apply.
- [ ] The packages build with at least one version of Delphi (which one: ...).
- [ ] The tests in `Tests` pass, if the control has them.
- [ ] The project files contain no settings of the local installation: `DCC_UsePackage` in the demos, `Excluded_Packages` with an absolute path, `FileName` of the images in the `.fmx` forms.
- [ ] The sources follow the [coding rules](https://github.com/Soft4You-IT/Soft4YouFMXControlSuite/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-rules).

By submitting this pull request I agree that my contribution is released under the [Mozilla Public License 2.0](https://github.com/Soft4You-IT/Soft4YouFMXControlSuite/blob/develop/LICENSE), as the rest of the suite.
